entries.subject: LDAP scope and individual binding correction
entries.text: Correction: NetworkPolicy is entirely out of scope; do not read or change deploy/ui2. Permitted additional evidence reads: docs/design/UI2_0_C3_IDENTITY_SESSIONS_RBAC_CONTRACT.md, docs/design/M14_LOCAL_LDAP_AUTHORIZATION_ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/design/LDAP_TLS_TRUST_STORE_PIN_GAP_2026_09_12.md, docs/design/UI2_0_C3A_LOCAL_AUTHENTICATION_CONTRACT.md, and the existing role_bindings/RbacEvaluator source/tests necessary to design the successor. PO decision: LDAP authorization supports both (a) encrypted AD group-reference bindings and (b) encrypted individual directory-principal bindings. A role token may match either binding; both resolve solely server-side through the existing RBAC evaluation/audit path. Individual principal references are opaque/encrypted, never browser-visible or raw in logs. Four-eyes and self-grant protections apply identically to both binding kinds.
